description: This file contains functions and methods for managing Linux traffic control (tc) qdiscs, specifically implementing netem (network emulation) features, including creation, modification, deletion, and parsing of qdisc attributes. It also includes utility functions for timing and rate calculations related to network traffic shaping.

methods.name: NewNetem
methods.description: Creates a new Netem qdisc with specified attributes, configuring network emulation parameters such as latency, loss, duplication, jitter, and rate.

methods.name: QdiscDel
methods.description: Deletes a specified qdisc from the system.

methods.name: QdiscChange
methods.description: Modifies an existing qdisc in place.

methods.name: QdiscReplace
methods.description: Replaces a qdisc in the system, allowing handle change.

methods.name: QdiscAdd
methods.description: Adds a new qdisc to the system.

methods.name: QdiscList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of qdiscs on a specified link.

methods.name: parsePfifoFastData
methods.description: Parses data for pfifo_fast qdisc type.

methods.name: parsePrioData
methods.description: Parses data for prio qdisc type.

methods.name: parseHtbData
methods.description: Parses data for htb qdisc type.

methods.name: parseFqCodelData
methods.description: Parses data for fq_codel qdisc type.

methods.name: parseHfscData
methods.description: Parses data for hfsc qdisc type.

methods.name: parseFqData
methods.description: Parses data for fq qdisc type.

methods.name: parseNetemData
methods.description: Parses data for netem qdisc type, including latency, loss, reorder, corruption, and rate.

methods.name: parseTbfData
methods.description: Parses data for tbf qdisc type.

methods.name: parseSfqData
methods.description: Parses data for sfq qdisc type.

methods.name: initClock
methods.description: Initializes timing parameters by reading /proc/net/psched.

methods.name: TickInUsec
methods.description: Returns the tick duration in microseconds.

methods.name: ClockFactor
methods.description: Returns the clock factor used for timing calculations.

methods.name: Hz
methods.description: Returns the system clock frequency.

methods.name: time2Tick
methods.description: Converts time in microseconds to ticks.

methods.name: tick2Time
methods.description: Converts ticks to time in microseconds.

methods.name: time2Ktime
methods.description: Converts time in microseconds to kernel time units.

methods.name: ktime2Time
methods.description: Converts kernel time units to microseconds.

methods.name: burst
methods.description: Calculates burst size based on rate and buffer.

methods.name: latency
methods.description: Calculates latency based on rate, limit, and buffer.

methods.name: Xmittime
methods.description: Calculates transmission time for a given size and rate.

methods.name: Xmitsize
methods.description: Calculates size based on rate and ticks.
